name: Clipboard history
author: dvrshil
description: Raycast-style clipboard history: search, type filters, pins, rename, edit, OCR/QR, source app, time-window deletion, retention, and ignored apps. Reads the history Omarchy already records.

barWidget.description: Raycast-style clipboard history with pins, filters, and actions

schema.label: Shortcut
schema.description: Optional. A Hyprland chord such as ALT + V or SUPER + SHIFT + V. When set, the plugin adds one marked binding to ~/.config/hypr/bindings.lua (after a backup). Leave empty to bind it yourself.

schema.label: Keep history for
schema.description: Unpinned entries older than this are removed. Pins are never removed.

schema.label: Ignored apps
schema.description: Comma-separated app ids. Copies made while one of these is focused are dropped.
